note: Declared JUNA-Lite receiver chain: stage -> implementing symbols -> protecting suites.
A static call graph cannot recover these conceptual stages, so this file is the
authoritative mapping. tools/explorer/explorer_contract.py verifies every symbol
against the analyzer's symbol table and every suite key against suites.json
(exported from test/runtests.jl), so a renamed function or a dropped suite fails
loudly instead of leaving the chain page stale.
kind: shared = infrastructure both baselines also use; seed = runs once to produce
the starting candidate; iterative = inside the Lite refinement loop;
deployment = frame-stateful wrapping of the per-block receiver.
evidence: direct = at least one declared suite textually names a stage symbol
(contract-enforced against the coverage scan); behavioral = the declared suites
exercise the stage through the public API without naming internals - rendered
as declared-only on the coverage page, never as a direct reference.

stages.title: Acquisition and block setup
stages.detail: Synchronization (LFM or rpchan preamble), guard handling, and partial-FFT branch spectra yparts.

stages.title: Partial-FFT seed candidate
stages.detail: Pilot-trained per-band combining (with the standard one-tap branch as fallback comparator) equalizes and BP-decodes the initial candidate. Lite starts where Partial-FFT+FEC ends; a valid seed returns immediately.

stages.title: Posterior interpretation
stages.detail: BP posterior log-metrics become symbol decisions and per-tone confidences.

stages.title: Feedback anchor selection
stages.detail: Pilots always anchor; confident data decisions join up to the anchor cap. The :frozen/:genie/:graded arms swap decision anchors for nothing or for (corrupted) truth without changing the code path.

stages.title: Confidence-weighted combiner refit
stages.detail: Weighted ridge refit of the partial-FFT combiner W toward the anchors. Lite refits W only; the physical response C is never formed.

stages.title: Re-equalize and re-decode
stages.detail: The refit combiner re-equalizes the branch spectra and BP re-decodes into a fresh candidate; payload extraction credits correct bits.

stages.title: Candidate selection and stopping
stages.detail: Keep the best candidate by validity then syndrome; stop on success, non-improvement, or the iteration limit.

stages.title: Frame-stateful deployment
stages.detail: The per-block Lite receiver deployed across a frame-wide LDPC graph (frame_receiver = :lite / :stateful_lite), as the mechanism suites exercise it.
